initial_segment: travel agencies and small tourism operators in Agadir/Souss-Massa

offer_hypothesis.name: Mobile-first digital service pack
scope: service descriptions in up to two agreed languages
exclusions: unlicensed use of client photos, logos, or copy
offer_hypothesis.pricing_rule: Quote only after confirming scope; do not invent a market price. Agree in writing before work starts.

hypotheses.H0: The offer does not produce a qualified buyer or paid pilot in the frozen 7-day test window.
hypotheses.H1: At least one unrelated business agrees to and pays for the defined pilot during the 7-day test window.
hypotheses.H2: An international segment produces a better qualified response than the Moroccan segment; test only after payment/platform eligibility and comparable outreach are documented.

primary_endpoint: At least one real payment from an unrelated customer for the defined pilot within seven calendar days after the first valid outreach.
hard_constraints: no ads, inventory, paid APIs, paid hosting, or subscriptions
no outreach automation or bulk spam
no customer data collection beyond necessary public business contact details and recorded responses
no claim of customer demand without direct evidence

required_before_contact: specific digital problem observed and recorded
source URL for the observed problem
proposed fix is within the frozen offer scope

decision_rule.PASS_TO_CUSTOMER_TEST: A prospect has a source-backed, specific digital issue, a reachable business contact, and a free-to-deliver scoped offer.
decision_rule.HOLD_RESEARCH: Contact details or the digital issue are not yet verified.
decision_rule.FAIL_FOR_THIS_OFFER: The issue is outside scope, needs paid infrastructure before validation, or has no plausible direct buyer route.
decision_rule.COMMERCIAL_SUCCESS: Only after a real unrelated customer pays; simulation and desk research cannot satisfy this condition.

anti_bias: Freeze offer, scope, primary endpoint, and seven-day window before first outreach.
Log every eligible outreach and every response including silence and rejection.
Do not change the success threshold after observing results.
Do not use fabricated conversion rates, prices, revenue, CAC, or willingness-to-pay priors.
Keep this case separate from BHD, miRNA-21, and Quran/IQCL.
Do not modify the generic Simulation Matrix engine to embed commercial assumptions.

sources.use: Prospect discovery only; not proof of digital need or buying intent.
